links.to_node: The company's server system will be offline for a few hours due to scheduled maintenance.
The company's operations will experience a temporary halt during the server downtime.
The data processing speed of the company's server system will remain unchanged.
I avoid causing additional downtime beyond the scheduled maintenance period.
